name: Midea ducted
tagline: Compact Mini VRF ducted system with flare connections for simpler installation.
summary: The Midea MDV-V230WN1(AU) is an R410A Mini VRF outdoor unit paired with a high static pressure ducted indoor unit. It delivers 19.5 kW of cooling and 23.0 kW of heating.
Flare connections replace welding, and the ducted unit can be installed in sections for easier handling.

image.alt: Midea ducted system outdoor unit and ducted indoor unit

highlights.title: All flare connections
highlights.text: Flare joints replace welding, which simplifies installation and lowers its cost.

highlights.title: Installs in sections
highlights.text: The high static pressure ducted unit installs in sections, so each piece is lighter to handle.

highlights.title: Long piping runs
highlights.text: A total piping length of up to 200 m allows a wide range of system layouts.

highlights.title: Wide operating range
highlights.text: Runs in cooling from -15°C to 55°C and in heating from -20°C to 27°C.

highlights.title: Full DC inverter
highlights.text: The DC inverter compressor and fan motor adjust speed steplessly for efficient, consistent, quieter running.

highlights.title: Fine airflow control
highlights.text: Seven indoor fan speeds, and static pressure set in up to 20 steps from the wired controller.
